summary: CONSENT at 0 MUST-FIX and 0 SHOULD-FIX. D-207 records preview-product-boundary-successor.v8 as a DR-117 leftover remasurement and nothing more. Live required-now stays 28, G13 stays reserved and unnamed, file 08 and COORD are unmodified in the working tree, and no DR-G* row is proposed. All six cited digests reproduce exactly, as do all 94 internal pins of v8, all twelve of whose leftover-join citations are the current version with correct recording attributions. Both Stage A verdicts are ACCEPT 0/0, both are mode 0444, both pin the successor at f2e788e5..., and each records that it did not read the other. The non-unwrite span is complete at 44 ids with D-168 present. The subject did not move: same digest and same 0444 mode at start and end, at unchanged HEAD df1301a.
